Findings overview

A summary of the main issues visitors can see, grouped by area.

IssueWhy it mattersPriority
IssueWhy it mattersPriority

Data protection

The site collects children's details, including medical information, for camp registrations.

Camp registration software is out of date

High

Last updated in mid-2023. Older versions have publicly known weaknesses, and this is the software that stores children's details.

FixUpdate or replace it.

Email can be impersonated

High

Nothing currently stops someone sending email to parents that appears to come from the centre.

FixA one-off settings change on the centre's email.

Privacy policy is the default template

Medium

It doesn't cover the children's and medical information the site collects.

FixA policy written for the centre, approved by you.

Account ownership

To confirm

The centre should hold the logins for its web address, hosting, website, Microsoft 365, Stripe and Skedda.

FixConfirm who holds each one, and document it.
